name: Copper Forest
source:
Arrive in the town of Copper Forest-- a small town set in a world that resembles the northern USA in the 1940s. 

Helen and her close friend Arlene travel to the small town Copper Forest to visit Helen's estranged grandfather. However, even before arriving, the two can tell that something isn't quite right about Copper Forest. Why are the residents so hostile towards outsiders? Who has caused drastic changes in recent years? How will the two girls discover what's truly going on in the mysterious village? 

[from [url=https://astralynxx.itch.io/copper-forest-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
抵达铜森林镇——一个以20世纪40年代美国北部为背景的小镇。

海伦和她的好朋友阿琳前往小镇铜森林看望海伦疏远的祖父。然而，在到达之前，两人就看出铜林有些不对劲。为什么当地人对外来者如此敌视？近年来谁引起了巨大的变化？两个女孩将如何发现神秘村庄里到底发生了什么？
